status.reason: Pristine-ASM C analysis closes the spawned-contact final hop, direct respawn caller and camera-containment gate, timer-field correction, and Mine Plant interaction. Remaining species/presentation breadth is explicitly low-return and does not block the Phase 4 family binding.

order: No relevant retained D12 trace capsule exists in the Phase 4 capsule set, so no capsule was promoted as evidence.
C read the pristine retail PS-X EXE directly and checked constructor rows, instruction words, direct JAL xrefs, and control-flow predicates.
Previously accepted Interpreter observations are retained only for behavior already measured; no live replay was needed for the named static gaps.

spawned_burst_damage.old_claim: Flik's observed 4 to 3 health loss and knockback almost certainly came from a spawned kind 21, 22, or 23 object.
spawned_burst_damage.result: Falsified. Constructors 21, 22, and 23 select actions 5, 6, and 5. Their default contact block retires the contact with countdown 12 but leaves the player-damage selector s6 at zero, so the guarded 0x8004A700 call is skipped.
spawned_burst_damage.bounded_attribution: The old live event is consistent with the already-established ordinary actor-body-contact path because Flik was placed close to the worm. Exact historical-event PC attribution was not captured and is not promoted beyond that inference.

respawn_caller.old_claim: 0x80049C30 had no static direct caller and the trigger remained indirect/unconfirmed.
respawn_caller.result: Falsified. The executable has exactly two direct JAL xrefs: initial actor-pool construction at 0x8004A664 and dead-actor reinitialization at 0x8004D3F0.

respawn_gate.old_claim: The admission-radius check contradicted the observed move-away respawn behavior.
respawn_gate.result: Resolved. Live actors are admitted while inside the oriented camera-containment volume. Dead actors with an expired delay are reinitialized only when 0x80025084 returns false, meaning outside that volume. Moving the camera away permits reinitialization; returning makes the fresh actor visible again.
respawn_gate.player_distance_boundary: The predicate is camera containment around the spawn/actor, not a raw Flik-distance test. This explains why direct player-coordinate pokes were misleading.

respawn_timer.old_claim: The unresolved countdown belonged to actor +0x4A.
respawn_timer.result: Falsified. The reinit delay is actor halfword +0x62. 0x80049C30 copies spawn-descriptor byte +0x11 into +0x62, with special-case adjustment logic. +0x4A belongs to the separate death-animation/retirement lane.
respawn_timer.scope_limit: Per-record authored byte +0x11 values were not enumerated because the source and owner are now exact and enumerating level-local values has negligible Phase 4 return.

worm_burst.native: 0x80057B84 creates eight contacts cycling constructor kinds 21, 22, and 23 and aims orientation for actor id 40.
worm_burst.interpretation: The burst remains a real worm-native behavior, but the old evidence does not establish it as a damaging ranged strike.

mine_interaction.permanence_rule: The permanent-death and quota path runs only when the mine blast is lethal. A surviving worm merely loses two local HP.
